newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine gov't detects 30,000 fake pension claims.
newsitem.headline: Argentine gov't detects 30,000 fake pension claims.

text.p: Argentina's ANSeS social security department said Tuesday it had detected 30,000 fraudulent pension claims, and detection should save the country $120-190 million a year.
President Carlos Menem has repeatedly alleged there are 300,000 fake pension claimants in the country, costing state coffers $800 million a year.
But ANSeS senior advisor Angel Perversi told Pagina 12 newspaper that estimate had later been cut to 140,000, then only 30,000 cases had been detected.
He slammed a $30 million government census of pensioners as "an unprofessional fiasco" which did not produce results.
